route.instructions:
Choose one route for this prompt and run `flow route <route>`. You may read files first; other tools are refused until you route.
Items: `resume-work --item <id>` when the owner asks to continue or pick up an item; `refine --item <id>` for its requirements; `work --item <id>` for build, test, or review work; `new-work` for new work.
Other: `remember` to save to memory; `recall` when the answer depends on project history; `wrap-up` at the end of a session; `chat` for anything else.
Route `continue` when this prompt answers a workflow that is waiting.
